rationale: The headline behaviour — the Refresh/Run-query button now renders a visible text LABEL (was icon-only) — is asserted nowhere. Existing specs exercise the button's FUNCTION only: dashboard-refresh-without-cache.spec.js asserts clear_cache on the URL, dashboard-variables-auto-run.spec.js asserts the auto-run toggle and refresh variant, and panel-time/zoom-drag specs assert ViewPanel open/close + date-time. None assert the visible 'Refresh' label text. That label is the entire point of this change, so it warrants its own spec rather than squeezing a label assertion into a cache-flag or auto-run test. The enterprise-gated Cancel labels must be parked as test.fixme placeholders (not negative/absence assertions), so a dedicated spec keeps those fixmes together with the WIRED label tests.
